info.description: Postman collection for active Workslip.Api endpoints mapped in Program.cs. Base URL defaults to local API. Import directly into Postman.

request.description: Runtime health endpoint.
Creates organization and initial admin user. Saves organizationId + userId on 200.

exec: pm.test('organization view model hides internal timestamps', function () { ['createdAt', 'updatedAt'].forEach(field => { pm.expect(json.organization).to.not.have.property(field); pm.expect(json.user).to.not.have.property(field); }); });

request.description: Covers FluentValidation edge cases for required organization fields, CVR length/digits, and admin email format.

exec: pm.test('200 OK or 401 Unauthorized', function () { pm.expect([200, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
